edits.current: [Hosted owned checked-record acceptance](../evidence/owned-checked-record-promotion-20261026-aligned.md) binds eleven immutable archives to exactly 170 cells across seventeen profiles and both source routes. The acyclic Booking carries a copied checked Window; Claim retains its Ticket resource and checked quota. Full packages check borrowed and transferred inputs before ownership moves, project leased proof-free results, and exercise synchronous host callbacks and returned Lean closures. Standalone result-only packages expose Claim results without checked-input, transfer or callback metadata. Native PHP and PHP-Wasm have independent archives. Grant and its nested Subtype, arbitrary owned containers, recursive owned graphs, retained or asynchronous callbacks, other predicates, dispatch cost and peak memory are not covered.
